# Local Place Scan — find eateries/shops near a location

Find real, current local places (quán ăn, cafes, shops, services) around a location when OSM data is thin. Core insight: **an empty OSM result is NOT "no places"** — eatery and small-shop POI coverage in Vietnam (rural, small towns) is often zero, and Overpass mirrors 429/time out at peak. Google Maps has the real data; drive it with the debug Chrome via `browser_exec`.

## When to Use
- "tìm quán ăn / ăn sáng / café near <place>" or any "places near X" ask.
- The `maps` skill (`nearby`/`bbox`) returned empty or near-empty results.
- You need current ratings, review counts, or hours for small local spots.

## Procedure

### Step 0 — OSM first (cheap), then identify the administrative unit
- Try the `maps` skill once: `maps_client.py search "<name>"` (centroid + bbox), `nearby`/`bbox`. Keep whatever it returns; note the bbox.
- web_search the bare place name: Vietnam's 2025 mergers renamed provinces and wards (an old "thị trấn X" may now be "phường X" of a different province). Wikipedia + the ward's gov portal give the merger chain and the tổ dân phố/thôn list — reuse those names when grouping results by area.
- The geocode centroid is often a field — never treat it as the town center; a Maps search for a landmark (e.g. "chợ <name>") finds the actual settlement pin.
- Nominatim / the `maps` skill often returns EMPTY for VN ward & old-district names (live: "Neo, Bắc Giang" & "Thị trấn Nham Biền" → 0 results). Center fallback: open Google Maps `search/<area name>, <province>` and read `@lat,lng` from `location.href` (live: Yên Dũng/Neo → 21.20, 106.26), then bias every category query on that point.

### Step 1 — viewport-biased Google Maps searches (several SHORT queries)
(browser mechanics per skill `browser-control` §0 — ensure CDP :9222; `browser_exec` attaches automatically.)

URL pattern (`hl=vi` = Vietnamese labels):

    https://www.google.com/maps/search/<urlencoded-query>/@<lat>,<lon>,<zoom>z?hl=vi

- `@lat,lon,zoom` biases results to that viewport: 13–14z = whole ward, 15–16z = around the center. Center on the settlement pin, not the ward centroid.
- One query per term: category first ("quán ăn sáng", "quán ăn", "chợ"), then dishes ("phở", "bún", "bánh cuốn", "cháo", "xôi", "bánh mì"). VN breakfast clusters around markets — search the chợ by name too.
- Chain 4–6 searches in ONE `browser_exec` call: per query `new_tab(url)` → `wait_for_load()` → `wait_render()` → extract → print compact lines (keep prints short to survive output limits).
- Speed (live 2026-10-07, CDP attached): ≈2–3 s/query — 3 queries + nav ≈ 11–14 s total; the scan is cheap, prefer several short queries.

### Step 2 — extraction (results feed)
Poll until the feed (or h1) renders:

```python
def wait_render(t=20):
    for _ in range(t):
        if js('!!(document.querySelector("div[role=feed]") || document.querySelector("h1"))'):
            return True
        time.sleep(1)
```

Extract items:

```js
(() => {
  const out = {h1: null, items: []};
  const h1 = document.querySelector('h1'); out.h1 = h1 ? h1.innerText : null;
  const feed = document.querySelector('div[role="feed"]');
  if (feed) {
    out.items = [...feed.querySelectorAll(':scope > div')].slice(0,25).map(r => {
      const a = r.querySelector('a.hfpxzc');
      const img = r.querySelector('span[role="img"]');
      return {
        name: a ? a.getAttribute('aria-label') : (r.innerText||'').split('\n')[0],
        rating: img ? img.getAttribute('aria-label') : null,  // "4,8 sao 24 bài đánh giá"
        href: a ? a.href : null,   // keep full while working — !8m2!3d<lat>!4d<lon> carries coords
        text: (r.innerText||'').replace(/\n+/g,' | ').slice(0,200)
      };
    }).filter(x => x.name && !/xem hết danh sách|bộ lọc|xếp hạng/i.test(x.name));
  }
  return out;
})()
```

- Leading feed rows are filter chrome ("Xếp hạng · Giờ · Tất cả bộ lọc") — filter them out.
- A single-match search lands on a place page (no feed) — use h1 + `location.href`.
- Item text carries a local plus code (e.g. `776F+H43`) — keep it; pasteable into Maps search, pins spots with no street address.

### Step 3 — verify before labeling
- Reverse-geocode promising items' coords (`maps_client.py reverse <lat> <lon>`): listing address text lags renames; the reverse reports the CURRENT ward. Fix area labels before reporting (live: 3 hits were actually in neighboring wards, not the one searched).
- Sanity-check distances: 1° lat ≈ 111 km, 1° lon ≈ 104 km at 21°N.

### Step 4 — answer shape (Sếp's proven format)
- Group by area: center (ngã tư/market) → rest of the ward → markets → nearby 4–8 km.
- Per spot: **name** — ⭐rating (review count) — street/plus code — one-line note (dish + a real review quote when one exists).
- Links that work on mobile + desktop: `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<urlencoded name + area>`
- State plainly that most spots are small with few reviews (Google data as of scan day); never inflate. Offer the next step: drill into one quán (hours/photos) or route from the user's location.

## Pitfalls
- **Google Places API (official) is NOT available for Vietnam accounts** — Google lists Vietnam as a Prohibited Territory for Maps Platform; the Cloud Console blocks enablement with "Maps Platform unavailable in this region… prohibited territories" (verified 2026-10; ToS page `cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms/maps-prohibited-territories` names Vietnam). Do NOT try to obtain a key for a VN-billed account; use this browser scan (consumer Maps) or VN providers Goong/Vietmap/Map4D instead.
- **Goong API key requires manual admin activation**: signup works (Google-OAuth sign-in offered, no password), but key creation shows "Bạn chỉ có thể tạo key khi được admin kích hoạt" — the old auto-activate-after-24h mechanism is gone and a phone number is mandatory. Activation needs a support contact whose phone matches the account: hotlines **0869 697 502** (kỹ thuật) / **0904 522 538** (kế toán), or email **admin@goong.io** sent from the account's registered address — a Google-OAuth account has no phone on file, so state the registered email and offer a contact phone. `support@goong.io` is **DEAD** — it bounces `550 5.1.1 does not exist` (live 2026-10-06); the contact page now lists admin@goong.io only — never cc support. (Mail to admin@goong.io was accepted without bounce, same day.) Factor the support step into any promise of a Goong key.
- **Goong console has NO daily request cap** — the key-creation "Giới Hạn" tab restricts by URL/IP only; enforce usage caps client-side (free tier **1000 req/ngày**; auto-alerts at 15%/25% of the balance). Endpoints, params and response shapes for the v2 REST API: `references/goong-api-v2.md`.
- **Overpass mirror reality (live-checked 2026-10-06)**: only `overpass-api.de` works reliably — it takes transient HTTP 504s under load (retry). `overpass.osm.ch` returns EMPTY payloads (0 elements even for Hà Nội center — silent data loss; never use it). osm.jp TLS broken; kumi / private.coffee / openstreetmap.ru unreachable. The repo pipeline's `vn_geo.overpass_poi.fetch` retries per mirror (`attempts=2`, 90s timeout); CKAN fetches 60s. A tiny de result can be REAL rural sparsity (Yên Dũng bbox: 5 amenities total in OSM).
- Don't conclude "no quán" from OSM/Overpass emptiness — that's the normal state for VN eateries; this scan is the answer path.
- Don't run one long query ("quán ăn sáng ngon <xã> <tỉnh>") — Maps matches names poorly; several short terms sweep far more listings.
- A 14z search around a rural ward pulls in the next city's results — check each item's coords/ward (Step 3) before grouping; don't present distant spots as "in the ward".
- Review counts of 1–5 mean little — say so; prefer higher counts when ranking, and never dress a 1-review spot as "top".

## Cross-refs
`maps` (OSM/geocode/routing — try first) · `browser-control` (CDP mechanics; if its launcher doesn't bring :9222 up within ~10 s, use its manual Start-Process form — don't re-run the launcher in a loop) · `hermes-web-search-stack` (web_search for the place-name/merger research) · `email-sending` (sending a Goong/VN support email from the user's account).
